loadFailedBody: The data may not be ready yet. Try again in a moment.
overviewIntro: Month {month}. Each figure shows where it comes from; live and simulated records are never added together.
mIncomeHint: Invoices marked paid in this period
mReceivableHint: Issued in this period, not paid yet
mReceivableSource: internal payment records issued and open
mUnmatchedHint: Received in this period, no invoice confirmed
mAgeingHint: Open invoices: up to 30 · 31 to 60 · over 60 days old
excludedTest: {n} test records are left out of these figures.
trendIntro: Paid invoices, grouped by the week they were paid.
trendAria: Bar chart of income per week in the selected month
creditsIntro: Bank credits and manual entries, with whether NIVO could match each to an invoice.
creditsEmptyBody: Bank credits from the connected bank, the inbox or a manual entry appear here.
manualIntro: Use this for money you know arrived but NIVO did not see. NIVO tries to match it to an invoice and asks you when it is unclear.
fContentHint: As the bank shows it, for example the invoice code. This is what NIVO matches on.
manualDuplicate: This evidence was already recorded today, so nothing new was added.
manualFoot: Manual entries are labelled simulated in this build: nobody has verified them against a bank.
invoicesIntro: Internal payment records NIVO prepared from won deals.
invoicesEmptyBody: When a deal is won, Accounting prepares the invoice and it shows up here.
internalNote: These are internal payment records, not e-invoices issued to the tax authority.
ordersIntro: Confirmed orders that still have no invoice.
ordersEmptyBody: Nothing is waiting to be invoiced.
questionsIntro: NIVO stopped on these because it could not be sure. Decide here; the decision is recorded with who made it.
questionsEmptyBody: Nothing in Accounting needs your decision right now.
groupHint_unclear_payment: A bank credit that could belong to more than one invoice. Confirming a payment needs a written basis.
groupHint_over_limit: The amount is above what Accounting may issue alone.
groupHint_missing_data: NIVO needs a detail before it can go on.
groupHint_other: Other accounting work that needs a person.
ledgerIntro: Money in and amounts owed, built from invoices and payments. Open a line to see where it came from.
ledgerEmptyBody: Lines appear once an invoice is issued or money is received.
ledgerFoot: Expenses are not tracked in this build. A paid invoice with a matched bank credit is counted once, as that credit.
lineageIntro: Order, invoice, payment and the decisions behind it, in order.
adjustIntro: A correction is added next to the record. The original is never changed, so the history stays intact.
adjustNoteHint: At least 5 characters. Saved with your name and the time.
adjustAmountHint: Fill in only if the amount was wrong.
adjustNotReady: Corrections are not available yet: the workspace data still needs its update.
adjustManagersOnly: Only an owner or manager can add a correction.
errDate: Choose the date the money was received.
errContent: Enter the transfer content (at least 3 characters).
errAdjustNote: Write what needs correcting (at least 5 characters).
errTarget: That record could not be found.
errNotReady: Corrections are not available yet: the workspace data still needs its update.
loadRefused: You do not have access to Accounting in this workspace.
